items.title: Willie "Old Man" Parker Interview, 1958-11-07
items.q: Did Roy read? Yeah, he read too.

ctx.x: Did he, did he read too? Huh?
Did Roy read? Yeah, he read too. Yeah. He read too.

Yeah. You know, I've had many piano players around town. Piano players? Who? Piano? Piano. Well, the best piano player I've ever heard of. I've never known. We live out there by Albert, Tom Albert now. Right fellow. Mm-hm. Right fellow. Oh, yeah. Oh, yeah. Oh, yeah. Walter Deco? Walter Deco? Walter Deco?
